spanish: Y harás sus platos y sus cucharas y sus jarras y sus tazones, donde se derramará; oro puro los harás.
grammarChanges: Hophal imperfect 3ms tense corrected from present indicative 'se derrama' to future 'se derramará'; passive voice, third person, and singular kept.
Replaced the calqued resumptive relative 'que ... en ellas' (gender mismatch with masculine tazones) with the locative 'donde', keeping the same referent and clause role.
Replaced the non-idiomatic prepositional object 'harás a ellos' with the standard Spanish direct-object clitic 'los harás'.
readerNote: Used 'donde' instead of a gendered pronoun to fix the ellas/tazones agreement error without choosing which vessel noun is the antecedent.
